mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE exceeds 4% for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 3% signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings growth and compresses valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS declines by more than 3% over two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 2% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and increases recession risk, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO declines by more than 2% over two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4% combined with a 2-month decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 1% signals a synchronized labor market downturn, which reduces earnings and consumer demand, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS falls > 1% over 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both UNRATE exceeds 4% and PAYEMS declines by more than 1% over two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 3% combined with a 2-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 10% signals a synchronized demand contraction, which reduces earnings and increases recession risk, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 3% over 3 months and HOUST falls > 10% over 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both RSAFS declines by more than 3% over three months and HOUST falls by more than 10% over two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 2% combined with a 2-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 3% signals a synchronized supply and demand contraction, which increases recession risk and reduces earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 2% over 3 months and RSAFS falls > 3% over 2 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both INDPRO declines by more than 2% over three months and RSAFS falls by more than 3% over two months (t-test p > 0.05).
